question: Which of the following alcohols is commonly used as a fuel or fuel additive?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethanol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ethanol** is a widely used alcohol as a fuel or fuel additive because of its renewable and eco-friendly nature.
 
• It is primarily produced from the fermentation of crops like sugarcane, corn, and other biomass materials, making it a **renewable energy source**.
 
• When blended with gasoline, ethanol reduces harmful emissions such as carbon monoxide and particulate matter, thereby improving air quality and promoting cleaner combustion.
 
• Many countries, including **India, the United States, and Brazil**, have adopted ethanol-blended fuels to reduce reliance on fossil fuels and improve energy security. For example, India has set a target of achieving a **20% ethanol blend** with petrol by **2025**.
